== Summary ==
Marcin Solonczak in the Top 16 portrait grid of the 2002 Decipher ''Lord of the Rings'' TCG World Championship (DecipherCon 2002). Cropped to head and shoulders from the grid shown on the LOTR-TCG Wiki page [https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/Worlds_2002 Worlds 2002] (image: https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/images/wc_2002_top_16.jpg), where the portrait is labelled "Marcin Solonazik". Same portrait as DGMA [http://dgma.com/graphics/content/events/2002/deciphercon/MarcinSolonazik.jpg MarcinSolonazik.jpg].
* Page preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260208104034/https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/Worlds_2002 Internet Archive]
* Image preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016174826/https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/images/wc_2002_top_16.jpg Internet Archive]
* DGMA original: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030105002138/http://dgma.com/graphics/content/events/2002/deciphercon/MarcinSolonazik.jpg Internet Archive]
* Photographer: unknown (Decipher/DGMA event coverage).
